stories.title: Cloud dismisses dustup with 'irrelevant' Freedom
stories.summary: The Sky's Natasha Cloud was dismissive of Enes Kanter Freedom, calling the former NBA player an "irrelevant person" while saying she is focused on issues that are "actually [affecting] women and children."

stories.title: Source: Bills releasing Hardman, Wishnowsky
stories.summary: The Bills are releasing veteran returner and wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr., a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. A source also confirmed to ESPN that the team is releasing veteran punter Mitch Wishnowsky.

stories.title: Ohtani (knee) 'not 100%'; mound return uncertain
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani continued to feel discomfort in his left knee coming off his latest bullpen session, and the Dodgers are still unsure if he'll make his anticipated return to their starting rotation Sunday.

stories.title: Song KO's Nurmagomedov in massive UFC upset
stories.summary: Song Yadong pulled off a massive upset by knocking out heavily favored Umar Nurmagomedov in the men's bantamweight main event of UFC Fight Night in Shanghai.

stories.title: Leader Pogacar out of Vuelta after Stage 8 crash
stories.summary: Five-time Tour de France champion Tadej Pogacar has pulled out of the Spanish Vuelta after crashing during the eighth stage of the race.
